topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The flowers bloomed in my hands as soon as I opened the door, a vibrant cascade of petals that seemed to catch the sunlight. No card nestled among the leaves, just the gentle whisper of the breeze that seemed to carry their scent even deeper into the room. The air felt softer, the world a bit more colorful. I placed them in a vase that suddenly appeared on the kitchen counter, watching the water ripple invitingly as the stems found their new home. It’s as if the day decided to pause and let something beautiful take center stage, and I couldn’t help but smile, letting the warmth of it all fill the spaces around me.
